entry.title: Heavy Rain Watch
entry.summary: Periods of heavy rain, and amounts may approach warning criteria, especially about the ranges. Chance of upgrading to a Warning: Moderate.

entry.title: Heavy Rain Watch
entry.summary: Periods of rain with some heavy falls. Amounts may approach short duration warning criteria, with localised downpours possible. Rain easing from the north this evening and overnight. Chance of upgrading to a Warning: Low.

entry.title: Severe Thunderstorm Warning
entry.summary:
At Midnight, MetService weather radar detected a line of severe thunderstorms lying from WARKWORTH to MATAKANA to OMAHA.
This line of severe thunderstorms is moving towards the south, and is expected to lie from PUHOI to WARKWORTH at 12:30 am and from SILVERDALE to OREWA to INNER HAURAKI GULF at 01:00 am.
These thunderstorms are expected to be accompanied by torrential rain.
Impact:
Torrential rain can cause surface and/or flash flooding about streams, gullies and urban areas, and make driving conditions extremely hazardous.
